∀ {n : ℕ}, 3 ≤ n → ∀ {κ : ℝ}, 4 ≤ κ → ∀ (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ),     (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * Real.sqrt ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose))).det =
      (1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) *
      (((Real.sqrt κ + 1) • (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) -
        (Real.sqrt κ - 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)).det)
approved_definition_context: Matrix.transpose and Matrix multiplication have their usual real finite-dimensional meaning; c • A is entrywise scalar multiplication, 1 is the identity matrix and det is the determinant.

The anonymous statement fully expands its project-owned precision matrix. Matrix.orthogonalGroup means the full real orthogonal group, including both determinant components; Real.sqrt denotes the nonnegative real square root.
